title: Phantom save: banner reports the note was filed but the sample-app store never received it

evidence.player_belief: Tapped Save on the daily note; a green banner said 'Saved' with no further prompt, so the note felt filed.
evidence.ledger_truth: sample-app note store after the session still shows zero entries; the tapped Save never reached the store.
evidence.impact: Player leaves believing three notes were filed while the store holds none. A silent drop of user intent reads worse than an obvious error.

repro: open the daily note, tap Save, observe the green banner
reopen the note list: it is still empty
